rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Dr. Noshir Wadia
Exhibition name: Dr. Noshir Wadia
rows.Origin:
Discovered by C.R. Chiplunkar (India, before 1992).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in 1992 as 'Dr. Noshir Wadia'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red, white streaks, stripes, flecks, pink stripes. Mild fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, compact. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Notes: Different opinions on Introducer - see References
